messages.subject: Hollis exit — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As flagged on the call, we need to move on Gareth Hollis. The CRO role is going as part of the commercial reorg announced on 6 November. He's raised a grievance and is hinting his selection is linked to the revenue-recognition concern he flagged in August. We'd like you to advise on the grievance, run a clean settlement, and deal with his covenants. Maya (CFO) will sign off on numbers.

Can you send an engagement letter?

Sofia Trevino
General Counsel, Caspian Technologies

messages.plaintextBody:
Sofia,

Understood, and thank you for the instruction. Engagement letter attached — please countersign and return. James Osei will be my senior associate on this. I'll review the grievance papers today and we'll get an advice note and a draft settlement agreement to you this week. The protected-disclosure angle is the one to handle carefully, but on what you've described the redundancy looks genuine.

Best,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
